reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_rows drops the customer-demand text while building selected records. The assigned input contains concrete need strings, but the assigned upstream output has the same records with every need empty; this breaks the needs handoff and causes the downstream recommendation top_need to be empty.

normalize_evidence keeps the required records and evidence fields visible in the assigned output. The empty need values are already explained by the upstream selected records lacking need text, so this boundary is not localized as the behavioral fault from the supplied evidence.

assemble_provenance produces eight evidence-source handoff records with ranks, record IDs, source IDs, and source weights matching the assigned upstream output. No provenance ranking fault is visible in the supplied package.
